description: The most recent reported value of each metric for one ticker, each with its period (fy, fp), period end, filing date and form. Use it for a company's current figures, or with as_of for what had been filed by a given day; call search_companies first if you have a name rather than a ticker. Inputs: ticker (e.g. AAPL, 2330.TW, 005930.KS, 0403091220.BE, 775670417.FR, CC21860.NZC, and 10238429.EE, 5560356163.SE, 47239255.SK, 40003032949.LV where get_coverage lists them, and 96002925948.AU for Australia's tax figures); metric (comma-separated; a name we do not hold is left out); as_of (only filings dated on or before that day). On a free key, a company outside the full-history sample answers from its most recent reported fiscal year only (history_depth says so) and as_of needs a licence or an evaluation key. Each metric is its own latest value, so two metrics can come from different periods; a quarterly fp is ONE quarter's figure, not a year; check `stale` (true: the company has filed since without this metric, so the figure is not current). Before using the figures: they are as filed, each keyed to its filing date (`filed`) as its market records it (how each market dates a filing: https://www.tradingagentapp.com/fundamentals/methodology). .TW quarterly values are already SINGLE-QUARTER amounts: do not difference adjacent quarters. For a quarterly row (US, Taiwan) fy and fp are the CALENDAR quarter containing the period end, not the company's fiscal quarter. Each reply's `market_notes` and `schema` give the per-market caveats (solo or group accounts, lawful gaps, charities, flags in `form`); read them before interpreting a figure. Detailed line items follow local accounting rules and keep the filed sign (capex is negative in Taiwan and Japan): call get_data_dictionary before comparing them across markets. When you relay figures, keep the reply's `attribution` and `licence` notices with them.

as_of.description: Filing-date cut-off, YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. 2022-01-01). Defaults to today.

metric.description: Comma-separated metrics, e.g. revenue,net_income. Omit for all.

name: get_latest_fundamentals
title: Latest fundamentals for a company
